# Spectral Systems LLC — Spectral Flit-Filter (v1.1.0)

> Hardware-enforced sub-flit capability sanitization, AI model weight protection (85x Le Cam / 43.7k BBP wall), and cold-reset BAR0 hardware ratcheting for disaggregated CXL 3.0-4.0 and UCIe HBM fabrics. Verified across 38 zero-axiom Microsoft Lean 4 theorems (thm00..thm37), live 16nm AMD Virtex UltraScale+ HBM silicon on AWS EC2 f2.6xlarge (1,585 Core LUTs, 0 BRAM, 338.8 MHz, agfi-08becf3b40b169674 & agfi-03b742e2a9cd2c0f2), 7nm ASAP7 FinFET CMOS (9,678 core / 27,877 enclave cells, 0.003335 mm^2, 693 MHz, 3.728 mW), and CNCF k3s admission control (1.36 ms HTTP 403 block).

Spectral Systems LLC (CAGE: 268E1 | SAM.gov UEI: VTP2JPCJU3D9 | DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24047902) provides zero-BRAM physical-layer memory isolation and FIPS-204 ML-DSA-87 certifying policy compilation (spectralc) for shared AI accelerators, high-performance computing, and sovereign enclaves. All inventions conceived and reduced to practice solely by Eric C. Murphy at 100% private expense (DFARS 252.227-7018 / DEAR 952.227-14; All Patents Pending).
